'''"Lefty" Grandarak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. While on the Republic capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was stationed in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower's]] Commercial District, where he would spend his time at [[Mariyk]]'s cantina.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Lefty" Grandarak appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Advanced Class trainer for the Smuggler class, wherein the player would be sent by [[Sammo Kob]] to learn the skills of either a [[Gunslinger/Legends|Gunslinger]] or a [[Scoundrel/Legends|Scoundrel]]. Despite being called "Lefty", he carried his blaster on his right hip, as was typical for all single-blaster characters in ''The Old Republic'' base game. He was removed in Game Update 5.0, when advanced classes were made available on character creation rather than level 10.<ref name="TOR" />
